hook: Indiramma towers get *RERA* nod, so buyers can take bank loans
hook_b: Indiramma towers get *RERA* nod, so buyers can take bank loans
tldr: Indiramma Housing towers planned in Malakpet and Quthbullapur got Telangana RERA approval, letting beneficiaries get home loans.

beats.what: Telangana RERA approved the towers, which are yet to be built; applications are filed for towers in other localities.
beats.why: RERA approval lets banks lend to beneficiaries for their ₹6 lakh share, paid in four instalments.
beats.care: The state plans one lakh flats within the ORR; the pilot builds 480 flats each in 20 constituencies.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Each 480 sq ft flat gets a ₹5 lakh subsidy, and the undivided land share is registered in the beneficiary's name.

cards.q: Would a ₹6 lakh flat within the ORR work for families you know?

qs: When will construction actually start in Malakpet and Quthbullapur?

facts.t: The pilot builds *480 flats each* in 20 constituencies.
The state aims for *one lakh* affordable flats within the ORR.

viz.verdict: Beneficiaries pay a fraction of the estimated market price

viz.l: Who pays for a flat (₹ lakh)
viz.verdict: Govt also gives the land, on top of the ₹5 lakh subsidy

learn.t: RERA = Real Estate Regulatory Authority, which registers housing projects so buyers are protected

watch: RERA decisions on the other localities' towers; the government had said towers would be finished within a year.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: RERA approvals for two Indiramma Housing towers in Hyderabad

fact: Flats worth *₹30-40 lakh* go to Indiramma beneficiaries for ₹6 lakh
twist: It is the first government housing project in Telangana to get RERA approval.
